calibration.empiricalSpeedPoolFallbackRule: No eligible preceding60s displacements: degenerate0.03W/s pool, explicitly flagged
calibration.empiricalSpeedPoolRule: Every finite native consecutive displacement ending at an inside-domain point, with both timestamps in preceding60s; include stationary observations; floor0.03W/s; no Q75 replacement or upper speed exclusion
calibration.compatibilityTimeExplanation: Frozen calibrator requires negative preceding times. These actualElapsedTime values are shifted by -60 solely for that interface; pressure is calibrated retrospectively from first60s and held fixed for the complete run.
calibration.empiricalSpeedPoolUsage: Empty start history fallback only; missing-history arrivals must use rollingSpeedObservations with the frozen causal filter, never this fixed pool after eligible rolling observations exist.
calibration.rollingSpeedRule: For each missing-history arrival draw from shared observations with jittered arrival time-60 <= time <= timeBracket[0]. Each speed is an adjacent native displacement ending inside the ROI and floored at0.03W/s. No look-ahead or gap bridging.

pressure.selectionRule: One calibration from first60s of each recording, every5 native samples. Same occupied-node weighted Q75 versus isolated Q99 max. Nominal grid origin for calibration; per-seed random origin for simulation. No later recalibration.
pressure.weights: Node occupancy, not area: each represented person has total weight1 per snapshot
pressure.meaning: Exploratory operational onset; not identified physical jam density, not calibrated against validation counts
pressure.calibrationOverlap: Retrospective first-minute calibration overlaps evaluation at start, not prior-to-t0 or online predictive calibration.

observation.speedDefinition: One consecutive native displacement, with no bridging of missing source IDs
observation.emptyFrameDefinition: Zero emitted inside-domain tracks. True emptiness and detector failure are not independently distinguishable.

quality.genuineReentryUnmodeled: All second accepted episodes and initial-cohort reentries are excluded; real reentries cannot be distinguished from boundary jitter with this tracker

crossingIdentityCoverage.interpretation: Potential input identity coverage only. This does not count correctly simulated crossings or use future outcomes to accept demand.

quality.source: Historical automatic tracker: ID switches, missed detections, trajectory gaps and projection extrapolation remain unresolved
quality.demandBoundary: Two consecutive inside samples confirm arrivals. Route and velocity use history ending at timeBracket START. Confirmation sample only filters eligibility. No observed future exit is a route label.
quality.inferredOutboundBoundary: Confirmed internal tunnel births use independent deep-cut outbound demand proxy, never their observed internal position as a simulated insertion point
quality.endpointArrivalPolicy: No sample after the last recorded frame is read or fabricated. Last-frame arrivals lacking next-sample confirmation remain rejected by the unchanged two-inside-samples rule.
quality.retrospectiveMeaning: The first60s establish fixed pressure onset for an offline retrospective complete-record simulation. This is not an online predictive experiment.

geometryLaneGuard.scope: Target-route clearance only; interacting or initially off-centre agent trajectories are not guaranteed to follow this centre path
